notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
It's only 7 days before Back to Hearth is coming to Steam. 
If you were looking for a short, atmospheric, melancholic autumn game, this is it. 

5 houses of an abandoned village are waiting. You will need to restore order in the courtyards and inside the houses, restore the feeling of home comfort and kindle a fire in the hearth. All so that the villagers will no longer be afraid to return home.

September 25th - save the date.

Don't forget to wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642760/Back_to_Hearth/
